title: ranunculus pulchellus var. membranaceus
intro: Ranunculus pulchellus var. membranaceus, commonly known as the small-flowered buttercup, is a flowering plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus pulchellus var. membranaceus include analgesia, antiphlogistic, and anti-inflammatory activities, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include ranunculin, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is required to fully understand its composition and effects.
